name:
Adventure Time™:
ETDBIDK Update
description:
This update for your Adventure Time:
Explore the Dungeon Because I DON'T
KNOW! game contains several
improvements and fixes offering an
enhanced gameplay experience. In
addition, it addresses issues that
users might encounter toward the end
of the game.
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
